articles.title: Guide to applying for undergraduate admission (demonstration)
articles.content: This hypothetical guide summarises a typical undergraduate application process. 1. Choose a programme from the official prospectus. 2. Check the entry requirements for that programme. 3. Obtain and complete the application form. 4. Attach certified copies of certificates and identification. 5. Pay the application fee into the official university account. 6. Submit the application before the deadline and keep proof of submission. 7. Wait for an offer letter and follow its registration instructions. All steps must be confirmed with the Admissions Office because this guide is demonstration content.

articles.title: First-year student orientation checklist (demonstration)
articles.content: This hypothetical checklist helps new students prepare for orientation: read your offer letter carefully; prepare original certificates and copies; bring identification and passport-size photographs; pay the required fees and keep receipts; attend orientation sessions on academic regulations, library use and student support; register for your courses; and collect your student ID card. Confirm all requirements with the Registrar's Office.

articles.title: Where to find help on campus (demonstration)
articles.content: This hypothetical overview lists offices that commonly support students: the Registrar's Office for academic records and registration; the Finance Office for fees and receipts; the Dean of Students' Office for welfare, accommodation, clubs and counselling; the library for study resources; and academic departments for course-related questions. Contact details must be obtained from official university sources.
